description: Search products on carrefour.fr, browse a category, or pull current promotions. All results work without an account or proxy setup.

brand.description: Only return products from this brand, exactly as Carrefour lists it, for example 'LACTEL' or 'SAMSUNG'.
brand.title: Brand

categorySlug.description: Carrefour category slug or full category URL (mode=browseCategory), for example 'cremerie', 'smartphones-objets-connectes' or 'https://www.carrefour.fr/r/cremerie/laits/lait-demi-ecreme'.
categorySlug.title: Category slug or URL

maxItems.description: Maximum number of products to return (1-500).
maxItems.title: Max items

minRating.description: Only return products rated at least this many stars.
minRating.title: Minimum customer rating

mode.description: What to scrape from Carrefour France.
mode.title: Mode

nutriscore.description: Only return products with this Nutri-Score (food products).
nutriscore.title: Nutri-Score

organicOnly.description: Only return products Carrefour flags as organic.
organicOnly.title: Only organic products

promotionsOnly.description: Only return products Carrefour currently shows with a promotion or immediate discount.
promotionsOnly.title: Only products on promotion

query.description: Product search keyword, for example 'lait', 'smartphone' or 'yaourt' (mode=searchProducts).
query.title: Search query

sortBy.description: Product sort order. 'Rating' means highest customer rating first. 'new' is a legacy value that now falls back to relevance because Carrefour no longer exposes a newest-first sort.
enumTitles: Price per kg/L: low to high
Price per kg/L: high to low
sortBy.title: Sort by

title: Carrefour France Scraper Input
